name: FileDropzone
description: A drag-and-drop upload area that lifts and glows in the accent color while files hover over it, with a file list that springs new entries in, animates simulated upload progress, draws a check on completion and slides removed files out. Oversized files are rejected inline.
a11yNotes: The drop area contains a real <button> (described by the hint text) that opens the native file picker, so it works by keyboard and screen reader without drag and drop; the hidden file input is removed from the tab order. Each file shows a role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow and a labelled Remove button. A polite role="status" live region announces added, uploaded and removed files. Under prefers-reduced-motion entries fade without movement and the zone does not scale.

defaultProps.title: Drag & drop files here
defaultProps.hint: PNG, JPG, PDF or ZIP up to 10 MB

propsApi.name: title
propsApi.description: Main prompt inside the drop area.

propsApi.name: hint
propsApi.default: 'PNG, JPG, PDF or ZIP up to 10 MB'
propsApi.description: Hint line under the prompt; also describes the browse button.

propsApi.name: accept
propsApi.description: Value of the file input's accept attribute (e.g. 'image/*,.pdf').

propsApi.name: multiple
propsApi.description: Allow several files; when false a new file replaces the list.

propsApi.name: maxFiles
propsApi.description: Maximum number of entries kept in the list (oldest are dropped).

propsApi.name: maxSizeMB
propsApi.description: Files larger than this are listed with an error instead of uploading.

propsApi.name: uploadDuration
propsApi.description: Approximate simulated upload time per file in seconds.

propsApi.name: showSampleFiles
propsApi.description: Start with two sample entries (one complete, one uploading).

propsApi.name: accentColor
propsApi.description: Color of the drag-over state, file badges and progress bars.

propsApi.name: onFilesChange
propsApi.description: Called with the accepted real files whenever the list changes.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
